_comment: Help when the player seems stuck. After 'first_seconds' on the same objective a gentle hint appears; after 'second_seconds' a step-by-step one. Pressing the Hint key (T, or D-pad down) shows the step-by-step hint at once and flashes the objective marker. Per-area texts are under 'stuck' in data/story/<area>.json, keyed by objective.
first_hint_reminder: Stuck? Press T (or D-pad down) for a hint.
